title: Chrono-Core: The Echo of Prometheus
description: Shift between 2088 and 2140 in real-time aboard a shattered space station to prevent a temporal extinction event.

title: Crypt of Secrets: The Abyssal Archive
description: Navigate shifting subterranean catacombs beneath Victorian Europe where every unlocked door demands a dark sacrifice.

title: Neon Phantom: Tokyo 2099
description: Walk inside 3D holographic memory reconstructions of crime victims to alter small clues in the past and unmask a cyber assassin.

title: The Last Beacon
description: Traverse a frozen world of endless cosmic dark to repair massive light beacons keeping humanity safe from shadow hunters.

title: Valkyrie Down: The Ruins of Asgard
description: Crash land on a mythic alien planet where ancient AI constructs are worshipped as Norse Gods. Harness alien runes to survive.

title: Crypt of Secrets (Classic)
description: You find yourself trapped in an ancient family crypt. Solve puzzles to escape before your flashlight runs out.

title: The Accidental Treasure
description: A comedic adventure of a failing pirate who finds an ancient treasure map, only to discover it's a grocery list.

title: Guardian of Time
description: Your time machine malfunctions, landing you in ancient Egypt during the pyramid construction.

title: Sugar Cloud Academy
description: A magical fantasy adventure helping a flying teapot and baby dragon restore the colors of cotton candy clouds.
